messages:
sarah-partners: Hey team — Cloud partner asked for a Kubernetes quickstart that uses a Helm chart + a companion operator and a tiny Terraform wrapper for onboarding to the marketplace. Goal: make it one-click deployable from marketplace UI and also runnable as a template repo. Need owners and a short rollout plan.
jon-terraform: I can take the Terraform wrapper (module + examples). Do we want the TF to call Helm provider or just output k8s manifests?
mike-eng: Prefer TF->helm provider because partner marketplace flow expects a single infra step that creates k8s resources. Keeps UX simple. Also helps with cloud provider infra (LB, IAM) in the same flow.
ni-qa: For tests: can we add a smoke e2e that runs in Kind or ephemeral GKE and validates health endpoint, and a quick perf check for startup <30s?
sarah-partners: Yes on helm through TF. Ni, add a checklist for smoke tests and failure modes we need to catch for partner signoff. Put threshold numbers we can automate.
jon-terraform: Plan: module repo with: 
- examples/basic (helm via helm_release)
- examples/saas-marketplace (adds cloud IAM + LB)
- CI that runs `terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve` against a test cluster (kind/gke)
Also include outputs for service endpoint and grafana dashboard link.
mike-eng: Helm chart owner volunteer: I can tidy the chart and operator scaffolding. Will move operator to separate `/operator` subchart and keep CRD migrations idempotent.
ellen-docs: Docs will need: quickstart, marketplace install guide, validation checklist, rollback steps, and upgrade notes for operator CRDs. I'll draft the quickstart with code snippets and a 3-minute GIF.
ni-qa: For CI, suggest matrix: Kind on Linux runner (fast), GKE small cluster (nightly). Smoke test script: `curl --retry 5 --max-time 3 http://$SERVICE_IP/healthz || exit 1` and `kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-quickstart -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.phase}'`
sarah-partners: One more product constraint from partner: chart must be configurable via values.yaml and support offline install (no external image pull on air-gapped customer). We need an image packaging doc and OCI registry manifest.
mike-eng: We'll add `values.imageRepository` and `values.imagePullPolicy`. For air-gapped flows, we'll provide a `bundle/` with images + manifests and a `make import-images` target that loads images to a local registry.
jon-terraform: Marketplace metadata: we need terraform templates with placeholders for marketplace-provided secrets (e.g., MARKETPLACE_TOKEN) and a small script `deploy-marketplace.sh` that swaps placeholders.
ellen-docs: I'll author the marketplace metadata file and sample values.yaml with placeholders. Will also write a short note on legal/packaging checklist to hand to partnerships.
ni-qa: What about automated validation for the marketplace CI gate? We should add a lightweight smoke-check GitHub Action that runs on PRs to ensure Helm lint + terraform fmt + `helm template` renders.
sarah-partners: Agreed. Action items: 
- jon-terraform: create TF module skeleton + CI (owner)
- mike-eng: helm chart + operator refactor + airgap bundle (owner)
- ni-qa: smoke tests + nightly GKE pipeline (owner)
- ellen-docs: quickstart + marketplace metadata + runbook (owner)
Deadline: propose initial PRs by next Wed (7 days).
jon-terraform: I'll open skeleton PR today, pinging @mike-eng for chart hooks.
mike-eng: I'll sync on chart conventions (values structure) tomorrow 10am PT.
ellen-docs: I'll drop a draft quickstart by EOD Tue.
ni-qa: Starting test harness tomorrow. Will stub GH Actions and post status here.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline created for repo `partners/helm-quickstart` — initial workflow added (lint, helm-lint).
sarah-partners: Great, thanks all. I'll set up a partner-facing demo next week and share credentials. :thumbsup:
jon-terraform: ack :+1:
mike-eng: :rocket:
ellen-docs: :memo:
